card.name: Waking Watcher
card.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, each player discards a card. Whenever Waking Watcher attacks, if defending player has no cards in hand, it gets +3/+3 and gains menace until end of turn.

card.name: Botched Experiment
card.text: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. If you do, draw cards equal to that creature's power.

card.name: Remain Unawares

card.name: Brutalize

card.name: Unstoppable Slaughter
card.text: Unstoppable Slaughter deals 1 damage to each creature and each player. Whenever a creature dealt damage by Unstoppable Slaughter this turn dies this turn, repeat that process.

card.name: The Collection
card.text: Instant and sorcery spells you control have rerun. (Exile the spell as it resolves if you cast it from your hand. Whenever a creature you control dies, you may cast that card from exile without paying its mana cost.)

card.name: Bedfellow
card.text: Bedfellow can't block or be blocked. Exile two cards from your graveyard: Bedfellow gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

card.name: Living Broadcast
card.text: Living Broadcast can't block. Whenever you cast a spell from exile, you may return Living Broadcast from your graveyard to your hand.

card.name: Veil of Innocence

card.name: Friends from the Beyond

Whenever a creature you control dies, you may cast that card from exile without paying its mana cost.)

Until end of turn, you may cast instant and sorcery spells exiled this way, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast them.

Rerun (Then if you cast this from your hand, exile it as it resolves. Whenever a creature you control dies, you may cast this card from exile without paying its mana cost.)
